svg.title: DUET in four panels
svg.desc: Comic. 1: plain GRPO gives every prompt 8 rollouts that run as long as they like; solved prompts give no signal and rambling rollouts waste tokens. 2: the Allocator gives more rollouts to prompts whose rollouts disagree and fewer to solved or long ones, n proportional to s over sqrt(L). 3: the Stopper snips a rollout once its boxed answer appears and aborts rollouts with no answer by K2, except an epsilon fraction kept with weight 1/epsilon. 4: one conductor, lambda*, keeps both on budget: tight budget means fewer rollouts and tighter gates. Result: half the budget, 2.51x faster and +5.3 MATH-500 vs full-budget GRPO on Qwen3-1.7B.

3 · The Stopper: stop once the answer is in
Boxed answer? Snip. No answer by K₂? Out,
unless the ε-coin keeps it (reweighted, unbiased).
4 · One conductor keeps the duet on budget: λ*
Half the budget → 2.51× faster and +5.3 MATH-500 vs. full GRPO (Qwen3-1.7B)
